    Distance from an origin

    Source: R/inv-spread.R
    inv_distance.Rd

    Adds the distance in kilometres from each record to an origin point, using the haversine formula for geographic coordinates and Euclidean distance (assuming metres) for projected coordinates.

    Usage

    inv_distance(.data, origin, lon = NULL, lat = NULL, name = "distance_km")

    Arguments

    .data

    A data frame, inv_occurrence() table or sf POINT layer.

    origin

    Numeric vector of length two: the x (longitude) and y (latitude) of the origin.

    lon, lat

    <tidy-select> Coordinate columns. Not needed for <inv_occurrence> or sf input.

    name

    Name of the new column.

    Value

    .data with an extra numeric column of distances in kilometres.

    Examples

    # Distance of each cane toad record from the 1935 release at Gordonvale
inv_distance(cane_toad, origin = c(145.79, -17.10), lon = lon, lat = lat)
